selectionMethod: AI-curated under assets/content-policy.json after reviewing Days 1–3 and assets/content-ledger.json. Items prioritize closeness, contact, support, social distance, and relationship maintenance. 'catch up', 'these days', and 'every now and then' are deliberate review/transfer rather than new items.

vocabulary.usage: Diễn tả mức độ gần gũi về tình cảm/xã hội; thường theo sau bởi person/group.
vocabulary.example: I'm pretty close to my sister.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — foundational closeness frame that is reusable across family and friendship talk.

vocabulary.usage: Tập trung vào việc tương tác với ai đó có thuận hòa hay không; không nhất thiết hàm ý rất thân.
vocabulary.chunk: I get along really well with…
vocabulary.example: I get along really well with my teammates.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — high-utility distinction between interaction quality and emotional closeness.

vocabulary.usage: Dùng khi hai người duy trì contact theo thời gian, đặc biệt khi không gặp thường xuyên.
vocabulary.example: We moved to different cities, but we still keep in touch.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — core relationship-maintenance chunk with strong real-life usefulness.

vocabulary.usage: Diễn tả contact giảm hoặc biến mất theo thời gian, thường không hàm ý conflict.
vocabulary.example: After university, we kind of lost touch.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — useful contrast pair with 'keep in touch' and natural for relationship history.

vocabulary.usage: Nói về một người đáng tin khi bạn cần help/support; stronger than simply 'like'.
vocabulary.example: She's someone I can rely on when things get difficult.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — expresses trust/support with more semantic precision than generic positive adjectives.

vocabulary.meaning: ở bên, hỗ trợ ai khi cần
vocabulary.usage: Thường nói về emotional/practical support. Có sắc thái ấm và tương đối mạnh, nên dùng khi đúng với quan hệ thật.
vocabulary.chunk: She's always been there for me.
vocabulary.example: My brother was there for me when I changed jobs.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — high-value support frame, included with a caution against overclaiming intimacy.

vocabulary.usage: Casual phrase cho shared history lâu dài; không nói chính xác bao nhiêu năm.
vocabulary.example: We go way back—we met in secondary school.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — common concise history chunk; useful but limited to contexts where long shared history is true.

vocabulary.usage: Nói về shared interests, values, habits or experiences.
vocabulary.chunk: We have a lot in common.
vocabulary.example: We have a lot in common, especially when it comes to technology.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — reusable explanation for why a friendship/connection works.

vocabulary.usage: Thường chỉ quá trình hai người bớt gần gũi theo thời gian mà không nhất thiết có một conflict rõ ràng.
vocabulary.example: We stayed friends for years, but eventually we drifted apart.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: NEW — precise relationship-change language distinct from an argument or breakup.

vocabulary.meaning: trò chuyện để cập nhật chuyện của nhau
vocabulary.usage: Trong Day 4, dùng như relationship-maintenance action sau khi đã học Day 1.
vocabulary.chunk: We usually catch up on weekends.
vocabulary.example: We haven't talked in a while—we should catch up.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: REVIEW/TRANSFER from Day 1 — scheduled reuse as concrete evidence of maintaining a relationship.

vocabulary.meaning: dạo này; trong giai đoạn hiện tại
vocabulary.usage: Dùng để contrast relationship history với contact hiện tại.
vocabulary.example: These days, we mostly keep in touch online.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: REVIEW/TRANSFER from Day 2 — reused to contrast relationship history with the current chapter.

vocabulary.usage: Hôm nay transfer từ routine talk sang contact frequency trong relationships.
vocabulary.chunk: We meet up every now and then.
vocabulary.example: We live far apart, but we meet up every now and then.
vocabulary.sourceSelection: REVIEW/TRANSFER from Day 3 — scheduled frequency retrieval in a relationship context.
